CustomField.description: [Peoplesoft] - Displays a green icon for a College Achievement Plan participant. Automatically set when the Contact has one or more Student Group records where Status is True and PeopleSoft Code is CP00, CP01, or CP02.
CustomField.formula: IF(CAP_Student_Group_Count__c > 0, IMAGE("/resource/CAP_Student_Indicator","CAP Participant",20,20), IF(CAP_Ineligible_Student_Group_Count__c > 0, IMAGE("/resource/CAP_Student_Indicator_Ineligable","CAP Ineligible",20,20), IF(CAP_Possible__c, IMAGE("/resource/CAP_Student_Indicator_Potential","CAP Possible",20,20), "")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Displays a green icon for a College Achievement Plan participant. Automatically set when the Contact has one or more Student Group records where Status is True and PeopleSoft Code is CP00, CP01, or CP02.
CustomField.label: CAP
